mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index falls below 45, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals supply chain disruptions that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM falls below 45 but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the 10-year Treasury yield rises by more than 50 basis points in a month, it signals a rapid tightening of financial conditions that will negatively impact equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: DGS10 rises > 50bps in 1 month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall by more than 10% year-over-year while the unemployment rate is rising, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y growth < -10% and UNRATE rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the employment-to-population ratio falls by more than 1 percentage point from its 12-month high, it signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: EMRATIO falls > 1pp from 12-month high but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the spread between the 10-year Treasury yield and the federal funds rate inverts, it signals an impending recession that will negatively impact equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: DGS10 < FEDFUNDS but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM services index falls by more than 5 points from its 6-month high, it signals a weakening services sector that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: ISM services falls > 5 points from 6-month high
failure_condition: ISM services falls > 5 points from 6-month high but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
